communityOrder.description: The user's communities in their preferred sidebar order.

gifFavorites.description: GIFs the user saved from the picker, stored whole. A saved GIF has to render without another lookup, and an identifier cannot be turned back into one: a GIF favourited from a chat message carries its own URL as the id rather than a provider key, so no provider can resolve it.

shareActivity.description: Whether the AppView may read the user's listening records from the services they publish to and show what they are playing to others.
